greeting.text: Ha! Fresh face in Hearthholm! Name's Rowan. I run the Adventurer's Guild here. What can I do for you?

responses.text: I'd like to join the Guild.
I'm ready to go after the chieftain.

registration.text: Eager, are you? I like that. Sign the ledger and you're one of us. We look out for our own.

responses.text: What do I get out of it?
I need to think about it.

registered.text: Welcome aboard! Ha ha! Now go talk to Kira at the training yard. She'll knock the green off you.

responses.text: What work have you got for me?

guild_benefits.text: Bounty boards, a warm bed, and folk who'll drag you home if things go sideways. That enough?

kira_directions.text: East side of town, past the well. You'll hear her before you see her. Woman fights like thunder.

about_guild.text: We're the thin line between Hearthholm and everything that wants it dead. Founded it myself, twenty years back.

responses.text: Twenty years? You must have seen a lot.
Sounds dangerous. I'll pass for now.

rowan_past.text: Aye. Lost friends, gained scars. But every life we save makes the rest worth it. That's the truth of it.

responses.text: Tell me about the goblin problem.

goblin_threat.text: Goblins out of Thornwood are getting bolder. Raiding farms, ambushing travelers. Something's riling them up.

responses.text: What do you need me to do?

goblin_task.text: Start with patrols along the east road. Thin their numbers. Prove yourself and I'll trust you with more.

task_accepted.text: Good. Don't be a hero out there. Come back alive and we'll share a drink. Ha!

goblin_suspicion.text: Goblins don't organize like this on their own. Someone or something is pulling the strings. Worries me.

responses.text: Let me help. What can I do?

chieftain_quest.text: You've proven your steel. Time to cut the head off the snake. The chieftain lurks deep in Thornwood.

responses.text: I need more time to prepare.

chieftain_details.text: Big brute called Skarnak. Smarter than most goblins. Holt's scouts found his camp near the old ruins.

chieftain_accepted.text: End this, and Hearthholm will owe you a debt. I'll have the Guild's best gear waiting. Go with fire, friend.

end.text: Steel and courage, friend. That's all you need out there. Ha!
